speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Roseola Infantum (Exanthema Subitum). Although the CBC and serology are currently negative, the clinical progression of high fever followed by a rash after fever defervescence is characteristic; however, given your presentation of low-grade fever with concurrent rhinorrhea and headache, this could also be a viral exanthem from Enterovirus or Adenovirus. Please ensure you stay hydrated and monitor for any worsening of symptoms.
